metadados.name: Quiet warm ochre sandy packed cave earth floor ↗ Solid impassable cave rock mass, dark purple
metadados.lower_description: Quiet warm ochre sandy packed cave earth floor, sparse subtle pebble clusters, flat walkable ground, muted golden brown #9d713c and #b78b4b, original 16-bit SNES action RPG pixel art, readable chunky pixels, no grass, no paving, no objects
metadados.upper_description: Solid impassable cave rock mass, dark purple charcoal brown #29242e with large rounded angular rock clusters, ochre mineral tips, original 16-bit SNES action RPG cave
metadados.transition_description: Continuous natural vertical cave cliff wall, 24 pixel high golden ochre rock facets #9e713c and #d2a052, purple brown deep crevices #48303b, selective dark outlines, irregular rounded rock corners, clean wall to sandy earth contact, readable native pixel clusters. Cave Gruta da Nascente: warm rocks contrasting turquoise water. No vegetation, no snow, no structures.

layout.description: 4x8 grid of transition (cliff) tiles. Tiles are one cell high; a cliff face occupies the map cell BELOW the terrain boundary (wall tiles carry corners with 'transition'). Use pattern_4x4 (row_0 = terrain above, row_3 = terrain below) to pick tiles.

pattern_system.description: 4×4 patterns with wildcards for flexible tile matching

pattern_layout.description: 4×4 grid where center 2×2 matches tile corners, outer ring uses wildcards

example.row_1: Wildcard + NW corner + NE corner + Wildcard
example.row_2: Wildcard + SW corner + SE corner + Wildcard

usage.description: Sample 4×4 terrain around tile position, encode as pattern key, lookup in cache
